scope: official pinch_tongs policy corpus; training-domain diagnostic with episode-held-out checks, not policy generalization

representations.z_c: frozen C3 native Contact transition code at exact t to t+27 [8,32]
representations.u_v_VAC: frozen B3 Vision projector target cache [8,32]
representations.u_v_VA27: frozen clean VA-only Vision projector target cache [8,32]

labels.force_definition: log1p(L2 norm of each region's two force channels)

probe.model: TRAIN-standardized multivariate ridge with no hyperparameter selection

subsets.boundary: any-contact toggles from current to future
subsets.dynamic: any occupancy change or total absolute force trend above TRAIN 75th percentile
subsets.high_force: future total log-force above TRAIN 75th percentile

geometry: effective rank from full valid covariance spectrum

diagnosis_thresholds.SHARED_CONTACT_INFORMATION_LOSS: u_c normalized error is at least 10% worse than z_c and paired CI lower bound is >0
diagnosis_thresholds.TARGET_READOUT_MISMATCH: u_v_VAC normalized error is at least 10% lower than u_c and paired CI upper bound is <0
diagnosis_thresholds.TEACHER_DOMAIN_OR_SENSOR_LIMIT: z_c and u_c both fail to beat TRAIN-mean normalized error overall and on boundary/dynamic checks
